name: Containerwiese
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Containerwiese is located in the Austrian federal state of Tirol in the rural surroundings of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature, the site is surrounded by mountain meadows and forest. The mountain world offers a network of hiking trails in summer; in winter, several ski areas of the Alpen are reachable. The facilities include a sanitary container, parcelled pitches with electricity connections, and a supply and disposal station for motorhomes. A small kiosk for basic foodstuffs complements the offering, so that self-catering is possible. Guests can expect simple and functional camping infrastructure as a base for exploring the region.
